attempts.summary: Built a double-NAT path: node3 (lan-a, 10.10.1.3) sends to node4:8080 (lan-b, 10.10.3.4); node1 (VyOS) SNATs to its transit address 10.10.2.1 as traffic enters the transit network; node2 (OPNsense) SNATs again to its lan-b address 10.10.3.254 as traffic enters lan-b, so node4 records the connection source as node2. Verified end-to-end via curl and node4's access log, plus conntrack/pf state showing both NAT hops. Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes with changed boot markers and full post-restart recovery confirmed for each.
